concerns.text: FR-004 (Evaluation on held-out GSM8K test split and MMLU STEM subset) is missing a dedicated implementation task. T022 implements the script but lacks explicit [FR-004] tagging or description mapping to the specific benchmark requirements defined in the spec.

FR-005 (Statistical power via 10 seeds) is referenced in plan.md but has no corresponding task in tasks.md. T027 runs tests on 'multiple seeds' but does not explicitly mandate the 10-seed requirement or the seed management logic required to satisfy FR-005.

Success Criterion SC-001 (Reproducibility of results) is not explicitly covered by a task. While T002 and T006 handle seeds, there is no task explicitly dedicated to generating the 'reproducibility report' or checksumming artifacts as required by the SC.

Success Criterion SC-002 (Statistical significance p < 0.05) is not explicitly covered by a task. T027 and T028 handle the calculation, but no task explicitly validates the output against the SC-002 threshold or logs the pass/fail status of the hypothesis.

Task T018 contains a 'Research question' and 'Method' block embedded within the task description that does not match the standard task format. This appears to be a copy-paste error from the spec or plan, creating a stale/invalid tag structure that should be cleaned up.

Task T011b references 'Review: ada-lovelace-simulated__2026-05-19' which is a review artifact ID, not a spec requirement ID. While the intent (compliance) is valid, the tag format is inconsistent with the [FR-NNN]/[SC-NNN] standard used elsewhere, making traceability ambiguous.
